sections.about: ❚❚ Our Story 城市裡， 一個值得留下來的夜晚 D Town by A Train 是台北大安區的創意餐酒館，屬「字母系列」品牌旗下（A Train、B Line、C Park、D Town、E Village、F Gallery、U Square 共七間），位於 SOGO 忠孝館旁巷弄二樓，距捷運忠孝復興站 4 號出口步行約 1 分鐘。復古英倫風格，台北東區空間最大的餐酒館之一，主打手工特色調酒（可調甜度/酒感/酸度）、日本和牛、碳烤串燒、生蠔，以及台灣茶葉調製的茶嗨波 Tea Highball（11 種口味）。每人低消 NT$600（另加 10% 服務費），週日至週四 18:00–01:30、週五六 18:00–02:30，適合 1 至 10 人聚餐。訂位請於下午 4 點後致電 02-2721-2772 或使用 Inline 線上訂位。Good Food. Good Wine. Good Times. 《你需要一杯酒，因為你有話想說》。不需要特別的場合，只要一個想好好吃飯、喝杯酒、把話說出口的夜晚。推開二樓的門，是一片復古英倫風格、東區最大的餐酒館空間，昏暗而通透，每個角落都是屬於你的小天地。 捷運忠孝復興站 4 號出口，步行一分鐘，二樓有燈就到了。 閱讀完整故事 ↓ 招牌特色調酒 日本和牛 酥脆炸物 18:00 每日開始營業 02:30 週五六深夜場 NT.600 每人低消 2F 忠孝東路四段49巷2號

sections.faq: FAQ 第一次來最常問的問題 把客人最在意的資訊先整理好，讓你不用一直往下找。 D Town by A Train 在哪裡？ 台北市大安區忠孝東路四段 49 巷 2 號 2 樓，鄰近忠孝復興站 4 號出口，步行約 1 分鐘。 入口在哪裡？ 面對 Qmomo 右手邊、路燈旁的小門，搭電梯上二樓即到。 營業時間是什麼？ 週日到週四 18:00-01:30，週五、週六 18:00-02:30。 低消多少？ 每人低消 NT$600，另收 10% 服務費。 低消以「每人」計算，餐點與飲品都可計入，點一份主餐搭一杯調酒通常就會達標。菜單分為主廚推薦、熱湯、小點、輕食沙拉、飽食主餐、甜點與手工調酒等區塊，可依人數自由搭配。 服務費為消費金額的 10%，於結帳時另計。付款方式接受現金、信用卡與行動支付。 可以怎麼訂位？ 訂位三步驟： 使用 Inline 線上訂位 ，或於下午 4 點後致電 02-2721-2772 。 平日建議提前 1–3 天；週五六與連假 4 人以上提前 5–7 天、4 人以下 3–5 天。 當天從捷運忠孝復興站 4 號出口步行約 1 分鐘即達。 抵達確認：面對 Qmomo 右手邊、路燈旁的小門搭電梯上 2 樓，看到門口招牌即代表找對地方。 有停車位嗎？ 店內無自有停車位，建議搭捷運（忠孝復興站 4 號出口步行約 1 分鐘）。 開車前來可停附近的金普頓大安酒店停車場，步行約 3 分鐘即可抵達。 週五、週六與連假前一天，附近路邊停車位通常較難尋找，建議直接搭乘捷運至忠孝復興站，從 4 號出口出站後步行約 1 分鐘即達。 店址位於忠孝東路四段 49 巷 2 號 2 樓、SOGO 忠孝館旁巷弄。入口是面對 Qmomo 右手邊、路燈旁的小門，需搭電梯上 2 樓。 可以帶寵物進入嗎？ 歡迎毛小孩一同前來！為了維護用餐環境，請盡量以推車或外出籠攜帶，感謝配合。 入口位於面對 Qmomo 右手邊、路燈旁的小門，需搭電梯上 2 樓，攜帶推車或外出籠時可直接搭電梯，不需走樓梯。 若同行寵物體型較大或不只一隻，建議於訂位時（下午 4 點後致電 02-2721-2772）先行告知，方便安排較寬敞的座位。 適合包場或辦私人聚會嗎？ 可接受小型包場與私人聚餐洽詢，詳情請於下午 4 點後來電 02-2721-2772 詢問。 D Town by A Train 是台北東區空間較大的餐酒館之一，座位有分區，從 2 人小桌到多人大桌都能安排，6–10 人的朋友聚餐或同事聚會不需包場也坐得下。 生日慶生、團體聚會與私人聚餐都可事先規劃座位、調酒與餐點，自帶生日蛋糕不另收切蛋糕服務費。包場與大型聚會建議比一般訂位更早安排。 適合幾人聚餐？可以坐大桌嗎？ 無論是一個人來享受微醺的 me time、2 人小酌，還是 6–10 人的朋友聚餐、同事聚會都很適合。 想坐大桌或多人聚餐，建議提前以電話或 Inline 線上訂位，我們會安排合適的座位。 店內空間多大？可以容納多少人？ D Town by A Train 是台北東區最大空間的餐酒館之一，復古英倫風格、座位寬敞，從 2 人小桌到多人大桌都坐得下，很適合團體聚餐與包場。 確切容納人數與包場方案，歡迎於下午 4 點後來電 02-2721-2772 洽詢。 可以辦生日慶生或團體聚會嗎？ 可以！生日慶生、團體聚會與私人聚餐都歡迎，能依人數安排座位、調酒與餐點。 請於下午 4 點後來電 02-2721-2772 一起規劃。 有素食或特殊飲食選項嗎？ 菜單以肉類、海鮮料理為主，素食選項有限。 如有特殊需求，建議訂位時先來電告知，我們會盡量協助安排。 菜單分為主廚推薦、熱湯、小點、輕食沙拉、飽食主餐與甜點，主要食材為肉類與海鮮，全素或蛋奶素的選擇有限。 若同行者有素食需求，建議於訂位時先行告知，現場會盡量協助調整。飲品方面，所有手工特色調酒都可調整甜度、酒感與酸度，另有以台灣名茶調製的 11 種口味茶嗨波 Tea Highball 可選。 調酒可以客製化甜度或酒感嗎？ 可以。全新特調酒單共 24 款招牌調酒，均一價 NT$380，分為 FROM THE VINE、FRUIT & FLORA、TEA & ORCHARD、SPIRIT FORWARD 四大類；另有茶嗨波 11 款，均一價 NT$280。所有調酒都可依個人喜好調整甜度、酒感與酸度。不知道點什麼，直接告訴服務人員你喜歡的風格，我們幫你推薦。 D Town 和 A Train 是同一家嗎？ 不是同一家，但是同一個品牌集團旗下的姊妹店。 「字母系列」目前共有 A Train、B Line by A Train、C Park by A Train、D Town by A Train、E Village by A Train（東村）、F Gallery by A Train、U Square by A Train 七間，各自獨立運營、各有風格。D Town by A Train 位於忠孝復興站，是其中空間最大的一間。 可以自帶生日蛋糕嗎？ 歡迎自帶生日蛋糕前來慶生，不另收切蛋糕服務費。 如有特殊慶生需求，歡迎訂位時一併告知。 未滿 18 歲可以入場嗎？ D Town by A Train 為餐酒館，依法未滿 18 歲不提供酒精飲料。 歡迎未成年朋友點選非酒精飲品與餐點，陪同成年人一起用餐。 茶嗨波 Tea Highball 有哪些口味？ 茶嗨波共 11 種口味，均一價 NT$280：01 紀州梅酒、02 大分麥燒酎、03 宮崎伯爵燒酎、04 花壇茉莉香片、05 名間四季春、06 宇治煎茶、07 鹿野蜜香琥珀紅茶、08 魚池紅玉紅茶、09 峨眉東方美人、10 鹿谷焙火烏龍、11 木柵鐵觀音。其中 01 至 03 以酒本身為主體（梅酒、麥燒酎、伯爵燒酎），04 至 11 則是先以琴酒自製成茶酒，再做成氣泡調飲。 不訂位可以直接來嗎？ 可以，但週五六與節慶前後座位競爭較激烈，建議提前訂位。 若要確保有位，建議於下午 4 點後來電 02-2721-2772，或使用 Inline 線上訂位。現場候位視當日狀況而定。 平日（週一至週四）營業至凌晨 1:30，現場候位的機會相對較高；週五、週六營業至凌晨 2:30，18:00 之後的時段人潮較集中。 若已確定日期與人數，使用 Inline 線上訂位可即時看到可訂時段；電話訂位請於下午 4 點後撥打。生日慶生或 4 人以上聚餐建議一律先訂位。 用餐時間多久？ 用餐時間基本上盡量安排三小時。 一般吃飯喝酒很夠用；慶生、聚會這類會坐比較久的場合，訂位時先說一聲，我們會盡量安排。這不是硬性規定，尖峰時段若有後續訂位，現場人員會提前告知。 要提前多久訂位？ 平日建議提前 1–3 天；週五六、連續假期與連假前一天，4 人以上建議提前 5–7 天、4 人以下建議提前 3–5 天，生日慶生或包場建議更早安排。 下午 4 點後致電 02-2721-2772 或 Inline 線上訂位。 適合約會或情侶嗎？ 適合。燈光偏暗、空間夠大所以不吵，雙人小桌有自己的角落感。如果是第一次來、不確定點什麼，可以直接跟服務人員說喜歡的風格，調酒可以調整甜度和酒感，不用怕踩雷。 有沒有包廂？ 沒有獨立包廂，但空間夠大、座位有分區。 若有座位上的需求或包場，歡迎下午 4 點後來電 02-2721-2772 討論。

mainEntity.name: D Town by A Train 在哪裡？

acceptedAnswer.text: 台北市大安區忠孝東路四段 49 巷 2 號 2 樓，鄰近忠孝復興站 4 號出口，步行約 1 分鐘。

mainEntity.name: 入口在哪裡？

acceptedAnswer.text: 面對 Qmomo 右手邊、路燈旁的小門，搭電梯上二樓即到。

mainEntity.name: 營業時間是什麼？
低消多少？

acceptedAnswer.text: 每人低消 NT$600，另收 10% 服務費。

mainEntity.name: 可以怎麼訂位？

acceptedAnswer.text: 訂位三步驟：1) 使用 Inline 線上訂位，或於下午 4 點後致電 02-2721-2772；2) 平日建議提前 1–3 天，週五六與連假 4 人以上提前 5–7 天、4 人以下 3–5 天；3) 當天從捷運忠孝復興站 4 號出口步行約 1 分鐘即達。

mainEntity.name: 有停車位嗎？

acceptedAnswer.text: 店內無自有停車位，建議搭捷運（忠孝復興站 4 號出口步行約 1 分鐘）。開車前來可停附近的金普頓大安酒店停車場，步行約 3 分鐘即可抵達。

mainEntity.name: 可以帶寵物進入嗎？

acceptedAnswer.text: 歡迎毛小孩一同前來！為了維護用餐環境，請盡量以推車或外出籠攜帶，感謝配合。

mainEntity.name: 適合包場或辦私人聚會嗎？

acceptedAnswer.text: D Town by A Train 可接受小型包場與私人聚餐洽詢，詳情請於下午 4 點後來電 02-2721-2772 詢問。

mainEntity.name: 適合幾人聚餐？可以坐大桌嗎？

acceptedAnswer.text: 無論是一個人來享受微醺的 me time、2 人小酌，還是 6–10 人的朋友聚餐、同事聚會都很適合。想坐大桌或多人聚餐，建議提前以電話或 Inline 線上訂位，我們會安排合適的座位。

mainEntity.name: 店內空間多大？可以容納多少人？

acceptedAnswer.text: D Town by A Train 是台北東區最大空間的餐酒館之一，復古英倫風格、座位寬敞，從 2 人小桌到多人大桌都坐得下，很適合團體聚餐與包場。確切容納人數與包場方案，歡迎於下午 4 點後來電 02-2721-2772 洽詢。

mainEntity.name: 可以辦生日慶生或團體聚會嗎？

acceptedAnswer.text: 可以！生日慶生、團體聚會與私人聚餐都歡迎，能依人數安排座位、調酒與餐點。請於下午 4 點後來電 02-2721-2772 一起規劃。

mainEntity.name: 有素食或特殊飲食選項嗎？

acceptedAnswer.text: 菜單以肉類、海鮮料理為主，素食選項有限。如有特殊飲食需求，建議訂位時先來電告知，我們會盡量協助安排。

mainEntity.name: D Town by A Train 的調酒可以客製化甜度或酒感嗎？

acceptedAnswer.text: 可以。全新特調酒單共 24 款招牌調酒，均一價 NT$380，分為 FROM THE VINE、FRUIT & FLORA、TEA & ORCHARD、SPIRIT FORWARD 四大類；另有茶嗨波 11 款，均一價 NT$280。所有調酒都可依個人喜好調整甜度、酒感與酸度。不知道點什麼，直接告訴服務人員你喜歡的風格，我們幫你推薦。

mainEntity.name: D Town 和 A Train 是同一家餐廳嗎？

acceptedAnswer.text: 不是同一家，但是同一個品牌集團旗下的姊妹店。「字母系列」目前共有 A Train、B Line by A Train、C Park by A Train、D Town by A Train、E Village by A Train（東村）、F Gallery by A Train、U Square by A Train 七間，各自獨立運營、各有風格。D Town by A Train 位於忠孝復興站，是其中空間最大的一間。

mainEntity.name: 可以自帶生日蛋糕到 D Town by A Train 嗎？

acceptedAnswer.text: 歡迎自帶生日蛋糕慶生，不另收切蛋糕費。如有慶生需求，訂位時一併告知可協助安排。

mainEntity.name: 未滿 18 歲可以進入 D Town by A Train 嗎？

acceptedAnswer.text: 未滿 18 歲依法不提供酒精，但歡迎陪同成年人用餐，可選非酒精飲品與餐點。

mainEntity.name: 茶嗨波 Tea Highball 有哪些口味？

acceptedAnswer.text: D Town 茶嗨波共 11 種口味，均一價 NT$280：01 紀州梅酒、02 大分麥燒酎、03 宮崎伯爵燒酎、04 花壇茉莉香片、05 名間四季春、06 宇治煎茶、07 鹿野蜜香琥珀紅茶、08 魚池紅玉紅茶、09 峨眉東方美人、10 鹿谷焙火烏龍、11 木柵鐵觀音。其中 01 至 03 以酒本身為主體（梅酒、麥燒酎、伯爵燒酎），04 至 11 則是先以琴酒自製成茶酒，再做成氣泡調飲。

mainEntity.name: D Town by A Train 不訂位可以直接來嗎？

acceptedAnswer.text: 可以，但週五六與節慶前後座位競爭較激烈，建議提前訂位。若要確保有位，建議於下午 4 點後來電 02-2721-2772，或使用 Inline 線上訂位。現場候位視當日狀況而定。

mainEntity.name: D Town by A Train 用餐時間多久？

acceptedAnswer.text: 用餐時間基本上盡量安排三小時。一般吃飯喝酒很夠用；慶生、聚會這類會坐比較久的場合，訂位時先說一聲，我們會盡量安排。這不是硬性規定，尖峰時段若有後續訂位，現場人員會提前告知。

mainEntity.name: D Town by A Train 要提前多久訂位？

acceptedAnswer.text: 平日建議提前 1–3 天；週五六、連續假期與連假前一天，4 人以上建議提前 5–7 天、4 人以下建議提前 3–5 天，生日慶生或包場建議更早安排。下午 4 點後致電 02-2721-2772 或 Inline 線上訂位。

mainEntity.name: D Town by A Train 適合約會嗎？

acceptedAnswer.text: 適合。燈光偏暗、空間夠大所以不吵，雙人小桌有自己的角落感。調酒可以調整甜度和酒感，不確定點什麼直接告訴服務人員喜歡的風格即可。

mainEntity.name: D Town by A Train 有包廂嗎？

acceptedAnswer.text: 沒有獨立包廂，但空間夠大、座位有分區。若有座位上的需求或包場，歡迎下午 4 點後來電 02-2721-2772 討論。

sections.about: ❚❚ Our Story An evening in the city worth staying for D Town by A Train is a creative gastropub in Taipei's Da'an District, part of the "Alphabet Series" brand (A Train, B Line, C Park, D Town, E Village, F Gallery, U Square — seven venues in total), located on the second floor of a lane beside SOGO Zhongxiao, about a 1-minute walk from MRT Zhongxiao Fuxing Station Exit 4. One of the largest bistro & cocktail bars in Taipei's East District with a retro British aesthetic, specialising in handcrafted cocktails (adjustable sweetness, strength and acidity), Japanese wagyu, charcoal-grilled skewers, oysters, and the Tea Highball series available in 11 flavours. Minimum NT$600 per person (+10% service charge), open Sunday–Thursday 18:00–01:30, Friday–Saturday 18:00–02:30, accommodating 1–10 guests. Reserve by calling 02-2721-2772 after 4 PM or via Inline online booking. Good Food. Good Wine. Good Times. You need a drink, because you have something to say. No special occasion required — just an evening to eat well, share a drink, and finally say what's on your mind. Push open the second-floor door and you'll find a retro-British space, one of the largest bistro & cocktail bars in the East District: dim yet open, with a quiet corner waiting just for you. From MRT Zhongxiao Fuxing Exit 4, it's a one-minute walk — look up for the lights on the second floor. sections.faq: FAQ The questions first-timers ask most We've gathered the details guests care about most, so you don't have to keep scrolling. Where is D Town by A Train located? 2F, No. 2, Lane 49, Sec. 4, Zhongxiao E. Rd., Da'an Dist., Taipei. It's about a 1-minute walk from MRT Zhongxiao Fuxing Station Exit 4. Where is the entrance? Facing Qmomo, look to your right for the small door next to the street lamp. Take the elevator up to the 2nd floor and you're here. What are the opening hours? Sunday to Thursday 18:00–01:30, Friday and Saturday 18:00–02:30. What is the minimum charge? There is a minimum charge of NT$600 per person, plus a 10% service charge. How can I make a reservation? Three quick steps: Book online through Inline , or call 02-2721-2772 after 4 PM. Weekdays: book 1–3 days ahead; Fri–Sat & holidays: 5–7 days ahead for parties of 4+, 3–5 days for smaller groups. On the day, we're a 1-minute walk from MRT Zhongxiao Fuxing Exit 4. Is there parking available? We don't have our own parking, so we recommend taking the MRT (about a 1-minute walk from Zhongxiao Fuxing Station Exit 4). If you're driving, you can park at the nearby Kimpton Da An Hotel car park, about a 3-minute walk away. Are pets allowed? Furry friends are welcome! To keep the dining environment comfortable for everyone, please bring them in a pet stroller or carrier where possible. Thank you for your cooperation. Do you host private events and gatherings? We welcome enquiries for small private buyouts and private dining. For details, please call us at 02-2721-2772 after 4 PM. How many people is it suited for, and can you seat large tables? Whether you're coming solo for a little me time over a drink, sharing a quiet round for two, or gathering 6–10 friends or colleagues, it's a great fit. For large tables or bigger groups, we recommend booking ahead by phone or via Inline so we can arrange the right seating for you. How big is the venue and how many people can it hold? D Town by A Train is one of the largest bistro & cocktail bars in Taipei's East District — retro-British in style with generous, spacious seating that suits everything from a table for two to large group tables, making it ideal for group dining and private buyouts. For exact capacity and buyout options, please call us at 02-2721-2772 after 4 PM. Can I host a birthday celebration or group party? Absolutely! Birthday celebrations, group parties and private dinners are all welcome — we can arrange seating, cocktails and food to match your party size. Call us at 02-2721-2772 after 4 PM and let's plan it together. Are there vegetarian or special dietary options? Our menu centres on meat and seafood dishes, so vegetarian options are limited. If you have special dietary needs, we recommend letting us know by phone when you book, and we'll do our best to accommodate you. Can I customise the sweetness or alcohol level of my cocktail? Yes. Our new signature list has 24 cocktails at a flat NT$380, grouped into FROM THE VINE, FRUIT & FLORA, TEA & ORCHARD and SPIRIT FORWARD; there is also the Tea Highball series — 11 highballs at a flat NT$280. Every cocktail can be adjusted for sweetness, strength and acidity. Not sure what to order? Just tell the staff what you enjoy and we will recommend something. Is D Town the same restaurant as A Train? They're not the same venue, but they're sister restaurants under the same brand group. The Alphabet Series currently has seven locations: A Train, B Line by A Train, C Park by A Train, D Town by A Train, E Village by A Train, F Gallery by A Train, and U Square by A Train — each independently operated with its own style. D Town by A Train at Zhongxiao Fuxing is the largest of the group. Can I bring my own birthday cake? You're welcome to bring a birthday cake — no cake-cutting fee applies. If you have special birthday arrangements in mind, feel free to mention it when you reserve. Are guests under 18 allowed? D Town by A Train is a gastropub. By law, alcohol cannot be served to guests under 18. Minors are welcome to dine alongside adults and enjoy non-alcoholic drinks and food. What flavours does the Tea Highball come in? The Tea Highball comes in 11 flavours at a flat NT$280: Kishu Plum Wine, Oita Wheat Shochu, Miyazaki Earl Grey Shochu, Huatan Jasmine, Mingjian Four Seasons Oolong, Uji Sencha, Luye Honey-Scented Amber, Yuchi Ruby Black Tea, Emei Oriental Beauty, Lugu Roasted Oolong, and Muzha Tieguanyin. The first three are built on the spirit itself (plum wine, wheat shochu and Earl Grey shochu); the other eight start as house-made tea liqueurs infused with gin, then finished as highballs. Can I walk in without a reservation? Yes, but Friday and Saturday nights and busy holiday periods fill up quickly. To guarantee a seat, call after 4 PM at 02-2721-2772 or book online via Inline. Walk-in availability depends on the day. How long is the dining time? We generally aim to allow around three hours per booking. That is ample for dinner and drinks; for birthdays or gatherings that tend to run longer, let us know when you book and we will do our best to accommodate. This is a guideline rather than a strict limit — during peak hours, staff will let you know in advance if another booking follows. How far in advance should I book? For weekdays, booking 1–3 days ahead is recommended. For Fridays, Saturdays, public holidays and the day before a holiday, book 5–7 days ahead for parties of 4 or more, or 3–5 days for smaller groups; birthdays and private events should book even earlier. Call after 4 PM at 02-2721-2772 or use Inline online booking. Is D Town good for a date? Yes. The lighting is dim, the space is large enough to keep things quiet, and two-person tables have their own corner feel. If you're not sure what to order, just tell the staff what you enjoy — cocktails can be adjusted for sweetness and strength, so there's no wrong choice. Is there a private room? There's no separate private room, but the space is large with distinct seating zones. If you have specific seating needs or are interested in a full buyout, call after 4 PM at 02-2721-2772 to discuss.

schema.name: D Town by A Train
schema.description: A retro-British style bistro & cocktail bar in Taipei's East District, one of the largest in the area and just 1 minute from MRT Zhongxiao Fuxing — featuring signature handcrafted cocktails, Japanese wagyu and Tea Highball.

mainEntity.name: Where is D Town by A Train located?

acceptedAnswer.text: 2F, No. 2, Lane 49, Sec. 4, Zhongxiao E. Rd., Da'an Dist., Taipei. It's about a 1-minute walk from MRT Zhongxiao Fuxing Station Exit 4.

mainEntity.name: Where is the entrance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Facing Qmomo, look to your right for the small door next to the street lamp. Take the elevator up to the 2nd floor and you're here.

mainEntity.name: What are the opening hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sunday to Thursday 18:00–01:30, Friday and Saturday 18:00–02:30.

mainEntity.name: What is the minimum charge?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is a minimum charge of NT$600 per person, plus a 10% service charge.

mainEntity.name: How can I make a reservation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Three steps: 1) Book online through Inline, or call 02-2721-2772 after 4 PM; 2) Weekdays book 1–3 days ahead; Fri–Sat and holidays 5–7 days ahead for parties of 4+, 3–5 days for smaller groups; 3) On the day, it's a 1-minute walk from MRT Zhongxiao Fuxing Exit 4.

mainEntity.name: Is there parking available?

acceptedAnswer.text: We don't have our own parking, so we recommend taking the MRT (about a 1-minute walk from Zhongxiao Fuxing Station Exit 4). If you're driving, you can park at the nearby Kimpton Da An Hotel car park, about a 3-minute walk away.

mainEntity.name: Are pets allowed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Furry friends are welcome! To keep the dining environment comfortable for everyone, please bring them in a pet stroller or carrier where possible. Thank you for your cooperation.

mainEntity.name: Do you host private events and gatherings?

acceptedAnswer.text: D Town by A Train welcomes enquiries for small private buyouts and private dining. For details, please call us at 02-2721-2772 after 4 PM.

mainEntity.name: How many people is it suited for, and can you seat large tables?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you're coming solo for a little me time over a drink, sharing a quiet round for two, or gathering 6–10 friends or colleagues, it's a great fit. For large tables or bigger groups, we recommend booking ahead by phone or via Inline so we can arrange the right seating for you.

mainEntity.name: How big is the venue and how many people can it hold?

acceptedAnswer.text: D Town by A Train is one of the largest bistro & cocktail bars in Taipei's East District — retro-British in style with generous, spacious seating that suits everything from a table for two to large group tables, making it ideal for group dining and private buyouts. For exact capacity and buyout options, please call us at 02-2721-2772 after 4 PM.

mainEntity.name: Can I host a birthday celebration or group party?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely! Birthday celebrations, group parties and private dinners are all welcome — we can arrange seating, cocktails and food to match your party size. Call us at 02-2721-2772 after 4 PM and let's plan it together.

mainEntity.name: Are there vegetarian or special dietary options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our menu centres on meat and seafood dishes, so vegetarian options are limited. If you have special dietary needs, we recommend letting us know by phone when you book, and we'll do our best to accommodate you.

mainEntity.name: Can I customise the sweetness or alcohol level of my cocktail?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our new signature list has 24 cocktails at a flat NT$380, grouped into FROM THE VINE, FRUIT and FLORA, TEA and ORCHARD and SPIRIT FORWARD; there is also the Tea Highball series — 11 highballs at a flat NT$280. Every cocktail can be adjusted for sweetness, strength and acidity. Not sure what to order? Just tell the staff what you enjoy and we will recommend something.

mainEntity.name: Is D Town the same restaurant as A Train?

acceptedAnswer.text: They're not the same venue, but they're sister restaurants under the same brand group. The Alphabet Series currently has seven locations: A Train, B Line by A Train, C Park by A Train, D Town by A Train, E Village by A Train, F Gallery by A Train, and U Square by A Train — each independently operated with its own style. D Town by A Train at Zhongxiao Fuxing is the largest of the group.

mainEntity.name: Can I bring my own birthday cake to D Town by A Train?

acceptedAnswer.text: You're welcome to bring a birthday cake — no cake-cutting fee applies. If you have special birthday arrangements in mind, feel free to mention it when you reserve.

mainEntity.name: Are guests under 18 allowed in D Town by A Train?

acceptedAnswer.text: D Town by A Train is a gastropub. By law, alcohol cannot be served to guests under 18. Minors are welcome to dine alongside adults and enjoy non-alcoholic drinks and food.

mainEntity.name: What flavours does the Tea Highball come in?

acceptedAnswer.text: D Town's Tea Highball comes in 11 flavours at a flat NT$280: Kishu Plum Wine, Oita Wheat Shochu, Miyazaki Earl Grey Shochu, Huatan Jasmine, Mingjian Four Seasons Oolong, Uji Sencha, Luye Honey-Scented Amber, Yuchi Ruby Black Tea, Emei Oriental Beauty, Lugu Roasted Oolong, and Muzha Tieguanyin. The first three are built on the spirit itself (plum wine, wheat shochu and Earl Grey shochu); the other eight start as house-made tea liqueurs infused with gin, then finished as highballs.

mainEntity.name: Can I walk in to D Town by A Train without a reservation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but Friday and Saturday nights and busy holiday periods fill up quickly. To guarantee a seat, call after 4 PM at 02-2721-2772 or book online via Inline. Walk-in availability depends on the day.

mainEntity.name: How long is the dining time at D Town by A Train?

acceptedAnswer.text: We generally aim to allow around three hours per booking. That is ample for dinner and drinks; for birthdays or gatherings that tend to run longer, let us know when you book and we will do our best to accommodate. This is a guideline rather than a strict limit — during peak hours, staff will let you know in advance if another booking follows.

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I book at D Town by A Train?

acceptedAnswer.text: For weekdays, booking 1–3 days ahead is recommended. For Fridays, Saturdays, public holidays and the day before a holiday, book 5–7 days ahead for parties of 4 or more, or 3–5 days for smaller groups; birthdays and private events should book even earlier. Call after 4 PM at 02-2721-2772 or use Inline online booking.

mainEntity.name: Is D Town by A Train good for a date?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The lighting is dim, the space is large enough to keep things quiet, and two-person tables have their own corner feel. Cocktails can be adjusted for sweetness and strength — just tell the staff what you enjoy.

mainEntity.name: Is there a private room at D Town by A Train?

acceptedAnswer.text: There's no separate private room, but the space is large with distinct seating zones. If you have specific seating needs or are interested in a full buyout, call after 4 PM at 02-2721-2772 to discuss.
